question: What is the rank of India in terms of the World's area among the countries of the world?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 7th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India is the **7th largest country** in the world by land area.
 
• It covers an area of approximately **3.287 million square kilometers**.
 
• The six countries ahead of India in terms of area are **Russia, Canada, the United States, China, Brazil,** and **Australia**.
 
• India occupies about **2.4%** of the total geographical area of the world.
 
• The country’s vast area includes diverse landscapes, such as mountains, plains, deserts, and coastal regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Area of India**: India’s total area is about 3.287 million square kilometers, with diverse geography that includes the Himalayan mountains in the north and tropical regions in the south.
 
• **Other Largest Countries**:
 
 
• **Russia**: The largest country, covering over 17 million square kilometers.
 
• **Canada**: The second largest, with an area of approximately 9.98 million square kilometers.
 
• **United States**: Third largest, spanning 9.83 million square kilometers.
 
• **China**: Fourth, with around 9.6 million square kilometers.
 
• **Brazil**: Fifth, covering 8.51 million square kilometers.
 
• **Australia**: Sixth largest, occupying about 7.69 million square kilometers.
